name: PCB Fab Laser SVG Export
description: Export SVG layers (B.Cu negative, B.SilkS, Edge.Cuts, drills, pads) for xTool laser PCB fabrication.
description_full: Generates up to four SVG files sharing one board-outline bounding box: an 'ablate' SVG containing the union of (board outline minus B.Cu copper) and B.SilkS, a 'cut' SVG containing Edge.Cuts, a 'drill' SVG of via and pad drill targets, and a 'pads' SVG that strips the remaining paint off the pads for soldering. Bottom layers are mirrored. 1:1 mm scale.
